note: Modello's scenarios: the stock host's runtime plays them (affrescoui test examples/modello/lisp/index.scenarios.json)

scenarios.name: modello-start
scenarios.note: The start scene: the cube selected and active, its name in the properties, the status bar's counts

scenarios.name: modello-grab-typed
scenarios.note: G, X, 2, Enter moves the cube two units along X; Ctrl+Z puts it back

scenarios.name: modello-adjust-last
scenarios.note: After G, X, 2, Enter the Adjust Last Operation panel shows Move [2, 0, 0]; its X field stepped moves the cube again; Ctrl+Z hides it

scenarios.name: modello-search
scenarios.note: F3 opens the search over the commands; Escape closes it

scenarios.name: modello-scale-cancel
scenarios.note: S, 3, Escape leaves the scale as it was

scenarios.name: modello-add-delete
scenarios.note: Shift+A opens the Add menu; X opens Delete; select all, then H hides and Alt+H reveals

scenarios.name: modello-assistant-open
scenarios.note: The assistant's panel open over the viewport, with no agent connected: the note on how to connect one and three suggestions

scenarios.name: modello-assistant
scenarios.note: Ctrl+Shift+A opens the assistant's panel and Escape closes it

scenarios.name: modello-views
scenarios.note: Numpad 7 looks from the top, 5 switches to orthographic, Ctrl+numpad 1 looks from the back, N opens the sidebar

scenarios.name: modello-save-and-open
scenarios.note: Ctrl+S saves the scene as JSON and Ctrl+O opens it again, as an undoable change; a cancelled dialog changes nothing

scenarios.name: modello-open-refuses-other-files
scenarios.note: A file that isn't a Modello scene (or one whose objects lack a place) is refused and the scene stays as it was

expect.is: Not opened: the file is not a Modello scene

scenarios.name: modello-header-transform
scenarios.note: The header's transform settings: the snap step from its menu and Shift+Tab, Normal orientation turns the gizmo to local, the bounding box pivot; proportional editing is shown disabled with its reason

scenarios.name: modello-header-display
scenarios.note: The display menus: X-ray with Alt+Z, the statistics overlay, overlays off with Shift+Alt+Z, lights hidden by kind, the navigation gizmo off, scene lights for the material preview

scenarios.name: modello-tools
scenarios.note: The toolbar's tools: a click with Cursor places the 3D cursor, Measure takes two points and shows the distance, Add Cube adds one where clicked; Transform is disabled; a click on nothing clears the selection and a box selects the meshes in it

scenarios.name: modello-sidebar-fields
scenarios.note: The sidebar: a lock keeps an axis still under G; the Tool tab toggles snapping; the View tab sets the focal length and orthographic view; the 3D Cursor fields move the cursor and Reset puts it back; the rotation mode is disabled; undo keeps the selection

expect.is: Locked: moving with the gizmo or G, R and S leaves it
Other rotation modes (quaternion, axis angle) aren't available yet

scenarios.name: modello-top-bar
scenarios.note: An editor's type menu swaps it with the area showing the chosen editor; the Image Editor shows the camera's render, the Text Editor the scene's notes; Modello has its own five workspaces; a workspace applies its preset (the timeline's size, the shading, the properties tab); the scene and view layer names can be edited, their pickers are disabled

expect.is: Modello has one view layer: more layers aren't available yet

scenarios.name: modello-outliner
scenarios.note: The outliner's display mode and filter menus, its chevrons, the collection's toggles, a double click or F2 that renames in place and the row's context menu all work; New Collection is disabled with its reason

scenarios.name: modello-properties
scenarios.note: The properties editor's panels edit the scene: the material's metallic and base colour (a picker, undone in one step), the world colour, a light's type and power, a camera's focal length, the frame range, the exposure, an object's and the collection's visibility; the search keeps the panels that match; the tabs and panels Modello can't fill yet are disabled and say why.

expect.is: Linking an object to several collections isn't available yet: M moves it to one
Pinning isn't available yet: the properties follow the active object

scenarios.name: modello-timeline
scenarios.note: I keys the cube at frame 1 and, after a move, at frame 5; the frames between are eased; Up and Down jump between keys; a key dragged on the timeline moves; Alt+I and Shift+Alt+I delete and clear; auto keying keys a move; the menus, the frame fields, the preview range and the markers work

scenarios.name: modello-clear-snap-maximize
scenarios.note: Alt+G, Alt+R and Alt+S clear the cube's location, rotation and scale (a locked axis stays); Shift+S's pie sends the cursor to the selection or the origin and the selection to the cursor; Ctrl+Space maximizes the area under the pointer and puts it back

scenarios.name: modello-adjust-rotate
scenarios.note: After R, Z, 30, Enter the Adjust Last Operation panel shows Rotation [0, 0, 30]°; its Z field stepped turns the cube again

scenarios.name: modello-copy-paste-render
scenarios.note: Ctrl+C copies the cube and Ctrl+V pastes it as Cube.001, one undo step; F12 opens the render window: the camera's view, lit, without markers; Save As Image writes a PNG; Close shuts it

scenarios.name: modello-shader-editor
scenarios.note: The Surface workspace puts the Shader Editor under the viewport: the cube's material shows its output node; Add > Checker Texture and Add > Color add nodes; dragging from a node's output to an input links them, the picker in the sidebar sets the colour, and the viewport draws the cube red; Delete removes the hovered editor's selected node with its link, and Ctrl+Z puts both back

scenarios.name: modello-pie-menus
scenarios.note: Z opens the shading pie around the viewport's centre: Wireframe left, Rendered right, Solid below, Material Preview above, X-ray at the top left, the current one highlighted; a click picks one and closes it. ~ opens the view pie: Left, Right, Bottom, Top, Front, Back, Camera and View Selected; Escape closes it.

scenarios.name: modello-material-slots
scenarios.note: The Material tab names the object's material: New adds Material.001 and gives it to the cube (the Shader Editor follows), the browse menu gives back the first, and unlink leaves the cube with none; each is one undo step

scenarios.name: modello-parenting
scenarios.note: The Object tab's Relations panel gives the added empty the cube as its parent, keeping its place (its translation becomes the cube's offset) and nesting it under the cube in the outliner; Alt+P clears it, keeping its place; Ctrl+Z puts it back; Ctrl+P parents the selection to the active object

scenarios.name: modello-shadow-blend
scenarios.note: The Data tab's Shadow panel makes the light cast shadows; the Material tab's Settings panel blends the cube's material, and Ctrl+Z makes it opaque again

scenarios.name: modello-viewport-display
scenarios.note: The Object tab's Viewport Display draws the cube as its edges, then as its bounding box; Ctrl+Z puts the edges back

scenarios.name: modello-individual-origins
scenarios.note: The pivot menu's Individual Origins: scaling every object by 2 doubles each one's size about its own origin, so none moves; the median point moves them apart

scenarios.name: modello-output-format
scenarios.note: The Output tab's Format panel: the frame rate (Right steps it by ten; the timeline and the playback follow it) and the resolution, whose shape the render window takes

scenarios.name: modello-view-orientation
scenarios.note: The View orientation: the gizmo and G with X lock to the camera's axes, so a move along X leaves the floor for the view's right

scenarios.name: modello-window-keys
scenarios.note: Ctrl+Page Down and Ctrl+Page Up (and the Window menu) step through the workspaces Modello has, wrapping around

scenarios.name: modello-collections
scenarios.note: The outliner's New Collection, M to move the selection into a collection (or a new one), each collection's own visibility, selectability and render toggles, and new objects landing in the active collection, all undoable

scenarios.name: modello-keys-in-order
scenarios.note: A keyframe inserted before the others takes its place in time order, so playback and the dope sheet's next and previous keys follow the frames

scenarios.name: modello-export-gltf
scenarios.note: File › Export glTF writes the scene as a .gltf file the person picks, its keyframes as an animation; a cancelled dialog changes nothing

scenarios.name: modello-collection-rename-delete
scenarios.note: Double-clicking a collection renames it; its context menu renames and deletes it, its objects moving to the first collection left; both undo

scenarios.name: modello-edit-mode
scenarios.note: Edit Mode: Tab on the cube makes its mesh editable; faces, edges and vertices are picked; E extrudes, I insets, Ctrl R cuts a loop, X deletes, undo puts the mesh back; Tab returns to Object Mode

scenarios.name: modello-modifiers
scenarios.note: The Modifiers tab: a mirror and an array stacked on the cube, the array's count stepped, one removed; Shade Smooth in the Data tab

scenarios.name: modello-parent-turned
scenarios.note: A turned parent keeps its new child where it was: the cube turned 90 degrees about Z, the light parented to it in the Relations panel keeps its place, and clearing the parent gives it back its world place

scenarios.name: modello-scenes
scenarios.note: The scene picker: New Scene adds an empty scene and shows it, the first scene comes back with its cube, Delete Scene removes the one shown

scenarios.name: modello-bevel
scenarios.note: Ctrl B in Edit Mode bevels the picked edge of the cube: a narrow face takes its place and stays selected; undo puts the edge back

scenarios.name: modello-gimbal
scenarios.note: The Gimbal orientation: after a quarter turn about Z, R X 90 turns the cube around its gimbal's X axis, so only its X angle changes

scenarios.name: modello-material-shadow
scenarios.note: Material › Settings: Cast Shadows off and on again for the cube's material, undoable

scenarios.name: modello-extrude-move
scenarios.note: E extrudes the cube's top face and the new face follows the pointer: Z, 1, Enter lifts it one more unit
